export function candidateIdentity(pr) {
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(pr?.number)||pr.number<=0||pr.base?.ref!=='main'||pr.base?.repo?.full_name!==REPO||!SHA.test(pr.head?.sha||''))throw Error('invalid_observation_target');
  if(!TRUSTED_AUTHORS.has(pr.author_association))throw Error('trusted_pr_author_required');
  let task='PATCHGATE-PR-'+pr.number;
  try {const text=/^```json\s*\n([\s\S]*?)\n```/.exec(pr.body||'');const id=JSON.parse(text?.[1]||'{}').task_id;if(/^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]{6,80}$/.test(id||''))task=id;}catch{}
  return {task_id:task,head_sha:pr.head.sha,pr_number:pr.number};
}
export function observerMode({event,enabled,inputs={},association}) {
  if(event==='workflow_dispatch'&&inputs.mode==='acceptance'&&enabled!=='true')return 'acceptance';
  if(enabled==='true'&&((event==='pull_request_target'&&TRUSTED_AUTHORS.has(association))||(event==='workflow_dispatch'&&inputs.mode==='observe')))return 'observe';
  throw Error('observer_disabled_or_untrusted_event');
}

WORKFLOW:
name: PatchGate A1 shadow observer (no automatic merge or deployment)
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/patchgate-a1-readonly-20261024]
    paths: ['scripts/patchgate-observe.mjs','scripts/patchgate-a1-acceptance.mjs','scripts/patchgate.mjs','scripts/tests/patchgate-a1.test.mjs','.github/workflows/patchgate-a1.yml']
  pull_request:
    paths: ['scripts/patchgate-observe.mjs','scripts/patchgate-a1-acceptance.mjs','scripts/patchgate.mjs','scripts/tests/patchgate-a1.test.mjs','.github/workflows/patchgate-a1.yml']
  pull_request_target:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Normal observation requires the switch; acceptance runs only while disabled
        type: choice
        options: [observe, acceptance]
        default: observe
      pr_number:
        description: PR to observe; no candidate code is executed
        required: true
        type: string
      failure_pr_number:
        description: Second docs-only test PR with a distinct head; acceptance mode only
        required: false
        type: string
permissions: {contents: read}
concurrency: {group: 'patchgate-a1-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || inputs.pr_number || github.ref }}', cancel-in-progress: false}
jobs:
  tests:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '22'}
      - run: node --test scripts/tests/patchgate.test.mjs scripts/tests/patchgate-audit.test.mjs scripts/tests/patchgate-a1.test.mjs
  observe:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'ltzyz2181-collab/ltzzz' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      vars.PATCHGATE_A1_ENABLED == 'true' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' &&
      contains(fromJSON('["OWNER","MEMBER","COLLABORATOR"]'), github.event.pull_request.author_association)) ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'observe'))
    permissions: {contents: write}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {ref: '${{ github.sha }}', fetch-depth: 0}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '22'}
      - name: Validate trusted runtime before observing candidates
        run: node --test scripts/tests/patchgate.test.mjs scripts/tests/patchgate-audit.test.mjs scripts/tests/patchgate-a1.test.mjs
      - name: Observe PR data and atomically reserve only the observation branch
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PATCHGATE_A1_ENABLED: ${{ vars.PATCHGATE_A1_ENABLED }}
        run: node scripts/patchgate-observe.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: patchgate-a1-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: work/patchgate-a1/
          retention-days: 30
  acceptance:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'ltzyz2181-collab/ltzzz' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'acceptance' &&
      vars.PATCHGATE_A1_ENABLED != 'true'
    permissions: {contents: write}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {ref: '${{ github.sha }}', fetch-depth: 0}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version: '22'}
      - run: node --test scripts/tests/patchgate.test.mjs scripts/tests/patchgate-audit.test.mjs scripts/tests/patchgate-a1.test.mjs
      - name: Manual docs-only runner acceptance while production switch is closed
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PATCHGATE_A1_ENABLED: ${{ vars.PATCHGATE_A1_ENABLED }}
        run: node scripts/patchgate-a1-acceptance.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: patchgate-a1-acceptance-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: work/patchgate-a1/
          retention-days: 30
